values.joint: Suspension / Fork / Compression damping standard

values.value: 2 7/12 - 3 1/12 turns out from stiffest, at the point where adjuster and body punch marks align
conditions: from full hard (clockwise until it stops)

values.value: 3 1/2 turns from stiffer to softer; adjust 1/12 turn at a time
conditions: adjuster on upper left side of shock

values.value: 11 clicks out from stiffest with punch marks aligned (first click is position 1)

values.value: 13 clicks or more (4 clicks per rotation)

values.joint: Suspension / Shock / Rebound damping standard
values.value: 5 - 8 clicks out from stiffest, where punch marks align (first click is position 1)

values.joint: Suspension / Shock / Rebound adjuster range
values.value: 17 clicks or more (6 clicks per rotation)
conditions: adjuster on lower left side of shock

values.value: Left side rear seat mounting bolt to drive chain adjuster lock nut, unloaded (rear wheel off ground) minus loaded with rider

values.joint: Suspension / Shock / Race sag sand track
values.value: Increase standard race sag +5 to +10 mm (reduce preload); stiffen compression and especially rebound

values.joint: Suspension / Shock / Race sag mud track
values.value: Reduce standard race sag -5 to -10 mm; stiffen compression and rebound; optional stiff spring

values.joint: Suspension / Fork / Sand track setting
values.value: Stiffer: increase compression damping or fit optional stiff spring (then softer compression, stiffer rebound)

values.joint: Suspension / Fork / Mud track setting
values.value: Stiffer compression damping and/or optional stiff spring (mud adds weight)

values.joint: Suspension / Adjustment step size
values.value: Low-speed compression and rebound: one click at a time; high-speed compression: 1/12 turn at a time; spring: one rate step at a time

values.joint: Chassis / Handlebar / Mount positions
values.value: Four positions: 26 mm forward (front holes, holder forward), 16 mm forward (front holes, holder rearward), standard (rear holes, holder forward), 10 mm rearward (rear holes, holder rearward)
